title: The Valley of Mortals
summary: Inside the Demon Spirit Land, Wang Lin finds the immortal energy so thin it feels like the mortal world, so he catches a local youth, Shi San, to learn where he is. Shi San leads him to a valley hidden by an ancient formation, and when its chief Ouyang Hua attacks, Wang Lin works out the formation and breaks it, only to find a village of mortals. He gives them healing pills, and they ask him to stay through the Night of the Haunting, when the land's spirits come out each full moon, explaining that an Immortal named Huang Long once settled their ancestors and set up the formation. In return for more pills, Ouyang Hua gives him what he was after, a spirit crystal of this world's own spirit power. That night Luo Yun of the Heavenly Ghost Path attacks for the crystal, and Wang Lin kills him with the Annihilation Finger and his forbidden arts, feeding the ghost's flame to his Kunji Whip. From Luo Yun's memories he learns that the land has nine regions under demon emperors, each sealing a Primordial Mystic Spirit, and that outsiders work their way up as soldiers through battle merit. Instead of joining an army right away, Wang Lin decides to build his own strength by teaching the villagers the Soul Flag technique.
events: Wang Lin catches Shi San to learn about the Demon Spirit Land
He breaks the ancient formation guarding Ouyang Hua's valley and finds only mortals
The villagers tell him about the Night of the Haunting and the Immortal Huang Long
Ouyang Hua trades him a spirit crystal for healing pills
Luo Yun of the Heavenly Ghost Path attacks; Wang Lin kills him and feeds his ghost flame to the Kunji Whip
Luo Yun's memories explain the nine regions, the demon emperors and the Primordial Mystic Spirits
Wang Lin decides to teach the villagers the Soul Flag technique and build his own power
introduced: Huang Long (the Immortal of the valley)
cultivation: Luo Yun: peak of late stage on the Heavenly Ghost Path. Wang Lin: mid Soul Transformation. The villagers have no immortal power. Merging with a Primordial Mystic Spirit is said to give a small chance at a realm called Divine Genesis.
